## Overview

This project involved the fabrication and analysis of a ZnO-NiO nanocomposite using an Ultrasonication-Assisted Mechanical method, with comprehensive characterization using spectroscopic techniques.

## Key Contributions

- Fabricated and analyzed a 1:1 **ZnO-NiO nanocomposite** using an Ultrasonication-Assisted Mechanical method.
- Characterized samples using **XRD, FTIR, and UV-Vis spectroscopy** and obtained distinctive intensity and absorption peaks.
- Achieved up to **90% similarity** between sample results and characteristic properties of lab-grade chemicals.
